question: Analyze the impact of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hiking cycle from 2022-2024 on US equity valuations, bond markets, and commercial real estate. What are the transmission mechanisms and lagged effects?

outline.title: Introduction: Understanding the Federal Reserve's Interest Rate Hiking Cycle
Transmission Mechanisms and Lagged Effects: Equities, Bonds, and Commercial Real Estate
Impact on US Equity Valuations: Effects on Stock Prices, Trading Volumes, and Market Sentiment
Impact on Bond Markets: Interest Rate Hikes, Bond Yield Curves, and Credit Spreads
Impact on Commercial Real Estate: Effects on Property Values, Rental Rates, and Capital Flows
